cc:Work.dc:title: Second Stage Average History
cc:Work.dc:description: The earlier two-source import-inclusive B2 history is preserved separately from the broader 23-source prepared checked compilation series. Compile-only circles and including-import dashed diamonds show distinct timing boundaries. Changed TypeScript reference commits break the line. Fresh P65 and P66 measurements use the same new reference. P91 freshly measures the installed genuine P90 B2 image, without a paired predecessor run. Latest compile-only mean: 1.306596x.
